sentences.en: I cannot forgive him because he insulted me in public.
sentences.zh: 我不能原谅他，因为他当众侮辱了我。

sentences.en: Though God may forgive, man is not therefore to forget.
sentences.zh: 虽然上帝可以宽恕，人却因此不必忘记。

sentences.en: You may as well overlook his sins and forgive him.
sentences.zh: 你不妨忽视他的罪过并原谅他。

senses.zh: 原谅, 饶恕, 对不起,请原谅
